title: Redundant installation of CMake and Ninja
bug_description:
While following the build-from-source guide in the README, I noticed that the dependencies for CMake and Ninja are installed redundantly—both via Linux commands and in requirements-build.txt:
- In the linux command:
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/ff0d56d03592aa03f3ced8359241d21df1783393/README.md?plain=1#L245
- In requirements-build.txt:
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/ff0d56d03592aa03f3ced8359241d21df1783393/requirements-build.txt#L3
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/ff0d56d03592aa03f3ced8359241d21df1783393/requirements-build.txt#L4

Although this redundancy does not necessarily cause bugs, eliminating it would improve code clarity and conciseness.

One suggestion is to remove the installation from one of the two locations—either the Linux command in the README or the package entries in requirements-build.txt—to avoid duplication.

cc @malfet @seemethere @svekars @sekyondaMeta @AlannaBurke
